segments.name: Content Merchandising
segments.description: Sells content goods and merchandise to customers.
segments.evidence: For the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024, content merchandising segment revenue increased by KRW 16,036 million (USD $10.0 million).

segments.name: Food and beverages
segments.description: Sells coffee and bakery products and earns franchise royalties and fees.
segments.evidence: Food and beverages segment generates revenue through the sale of coffee and bakery products, with key raw materials consisting primarily of milk, fresh cream, flour, butter, and related ingredients.

segments.name: Content production
segments.description: Produces media content under production service contracts for customers.
segments.evidence: The increase in content production segment revenue and content investment segment revenue is primarily due to incremental revenues from the acquisition of Six Korean Entities.

segments.name: Content investment
segments.description: Provides investment management services that manage financial assets for clients.
segments.evidence: The content investment revenues are received in exchange for investment management services that include a series of fund administration services, fund compliance, fund transfer agent services and fund distribution services.

revenueModel.text: Investment management clients pay a contractual percentage of the financial assets the company manages for them.
revenueModel.evidence: Investment management revenues are calculated as a contractual percentage of financial assets the Company manages for clients on either a discretionary or non-discretionary basis.

changes.text: In 2025 the company added the Content production and Content investment segments through its acquisition of the Six Korean Entities.
changes.evidence: The increase in content production segment revenue and content investment segment revenue is primarily due to incremental revenues from the acquisition of Six Korean Entities.
